Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing port districts to participate in activities related to job training and placement.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of port districts to participatein activities related to job training and placement; and amending RCW53.08.245.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 53.08.245 and 1985 c 125 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It shall be in the public purpose for all port districts toengage in economic development programs. In addition, port districtsmay contract with nonprofit corporations in furtherance of this andother acts relating to economic development. (2) Port districts are authorized to provide funding, property, andother port resources to assist nonprofit entities in the operation ofprograms for job training and placement associated with port tenants,customers, and local economic development related to port activities.
